entries.text: I'll see you monday.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Have you filed your report on this case yet?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: I was going to do it on my way home.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We'd rather you didn't.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: We haven't accounted for kobold's actions. Not all of them.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: But agent Reyes told me that kobold accessed information about all of us over the internet. About Mulder, too.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, that explains how he knew we'd respond to the first killings-- why he staged them to look like satanic ritual to make sure that we would.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: He wanted us on the case. We know that.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He bent everyone to think and do whatever he wanted.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: But we know all this already. It was a game. Every move was played out perfectly except the last one.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Not unless that was part of the game, too.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: What, to get shot in the back?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No. Kobold's body still hasn't been found.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Kobold's dead. Agent Doggett shot him. We all saw that.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Did we? Think back to agent Reyes's question. Why didn't kobold escape with the others when he had the chance? Why? Because he wanted to escape without anyone knowing that he'd escaped so that by the time it was discovered he'd be too far away for anyone to find him.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Satan.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Daemonicus-- the beginning and end of our case. A snake eating its own tail. We lost. Kobold told me so. He wanted us to see how brilliantly he played the game. How thoroughly we lost. The first victims, darren and evelyn mountjoy.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Chosen from the phone book. For what reason?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No reason, other than their names.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: And the third victim?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The doctor, monique sampson. And the last the man whose body is at the bottom of that river.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: It's not kobold.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The guard we assigned him-- the guard he knew he'd have once we transferred him.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Custer.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Checkmate.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Something still bothering you, agent Reyes? You don't believe his explanation?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It all makes sense to me as far as it goes but there's something else. Something he's afraid to explain.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: You mean that you felt the presence of evil?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No. I mean that he felt it, too.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: [ whispering voices ]
entries.speaker: Sound
